examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a Custom Layout
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a custom layout.

examples.title: Example 2: Determining Whether to Participate in Layout Calculation
examples.description: This example shows how to determine whether a component participates in layout calculation based on its position.

examples.title: Example 3: Obtaining the Child Component FrameNode and Setting Related Attributes
examples.description: This example shows how to obtain the FrameNode of a child component using uniqueId and change its size and background color using the FrameNode API.

examples.title: Example 4: Allowing the Child Component to Ignore Parent Component Size Constraints
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the fixAtIdealSize property of the LayoutPolicy object to allow the child component to ignore parent component size constraints.
